items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or null if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，如果无法解析该键，则返回 `null`。

items.source: key - the property name to resolve
items.translation: key - 要解析的属性名

items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding property values as resolved by getProperty(String).
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 `${...}` 占位符，使用 `getProperty(String)` 解析出的相应属性值进行替换。

items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding property values as resolved by getProperty(String). Unresolvable placeholders with no default value are ignored and passed through unchanged.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 ${...} 占位符，使用由getProperty(String)解析出的相应属性值进行替换。没有默认值的无法解析的占位符将被忽略并原样传递。

items.source: Resolve ${...} placeholders in the given text, replacing them with corresponding property values as resolved by getProperty(String). Unresolvable placeholders with no default value will cause an IllegalArgumentException to be thrown.
items.translation: 解析给定文本中的 ${...} 占位符，使用由getProperty(String)解析的相应属性值进行替换。无法解析且没有默认值的占位符将抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: Determine whether the given property key is available for resolution — for example, if the value for the given key is not null.
items.translation: 确定给定的属性键是否可用于解析——例如，如果给定键的值不为 `null`。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or defaultValue if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，或者如果无法解析该键，则使用 `defaultValue`。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, or defaultValue if the key cannot be resolved.
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，或者如果无法解析该键，则使用 defaultValue。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key (never null).
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值（永远不为null）。

items.source: Resolve the property value associated with the given key, converted to the given targetType (never null).
items.translation: 解析给定键关联的属性值，并将其转换为给定的 targetType（绝不null）。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if given text is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果给定的文本为 null

items.source: defaultValue - the default value to return if no value is found
items.translation: defaultValue - 如果未找到值，则返回的默认值

items.source: targetType - the expected type of the property value
items.translation: targetType - 属性值的预期类型

items.source: the resolved String (never null)
items.translation: 已解析的 String（永远不会为null）

items.source: Interface for resolving properties against any underlying source.
items.translation: 用于针对任何底层源解析属性的接口。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if given text is null or if any placeholders are unresolvable
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果给定文本为 null 或任何占位符无法解析

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the key cannot be resolved
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法解析该键

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the given key cannot be resolved
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果给定的键无法解析

items.source: text - the String to resolve
items.translation: text - 要解析的字符串

items.source: Chris Beams, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Chris Beams，Juergen Hoeller
